name: DB Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  db-integration-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        healthcheck:
          test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
          interval: 10s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

      pgbouncer:
        image: pgbouncer/pgbouncer:latest
        env:
          PGBOUNCER_DATABASES: postgres:postgres
          PGBOUNCER_USER: postgres
          PGBOUNCER_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports:
          - 6432:6432
        healthcheck:
          test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-h", "localhost", "-p", "6432", "-U", "postgres"]
          interval: 10s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

      mysql:
        image: mysql:8
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
          MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        healthcheck:
          test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-u", "root", "-proot"]
          interval: 10s
          timeout: 5s
          retries: 5

    env:
      # PostgreSQL
      PGHOST: postgres
      PGPORT: 5432
      PGUSER: postgres
      PGPASSWORD: postgres
      PGDATABASE: testdb
      # PgBouncer
      PGBOUNCER_HOST: pgbouncer
      PGBOUNCER_PORT: 6432
      PGBOUNCER_USER: postgres
      PGBOUNCER_PASSWORD: postgres
      PGBOUNCER_DATABASE: testdb
      # MySQL
      MYSQL_HOST: mysql
      MYSQL_PORT: 3306
      MYSQL_USER: root
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: root
      MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Run DB integration tests
        run: |
          go test -v -race -tags=integration ./... -coverprofile=coverage.txt -covermode=atomic
        env:
          GOMAXPROCS: 4
